title: Fountly
summary: A map for finding nearby drinking fountains. It combines OpenStreetMap with local public data where available.
problem: Finding a nearby fountain on a phone can still be difficult even when open data exists. Fountly turns those scattered sources into search and a map designed for use while walking.
audience: People looking for a nearby drinking fountain from their phone.
responsibilities: A world map that loads fountains on demand as you pan.
An OpenStreetMap adapter through Overpass, with support for local public data sources.
Mobile UI: search, clustering, detail sheet and «Get directions».
decisions: OpenStreetMap as the global base, with regional adapters for public data where available.
Viewport loading and cell caching: don't fetch the same area twice when you come back.
A narrow scope focused on search, details, and directions.
outcomes: A personal project published at fountly.app.
A mobile map with search, marker clustering, details, and directions.
contribution: Designed and built a focused utility that combines several sources of geographic data.
